```{python}
#| label: fig-netlist-interface-schematic
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "The named transistor and its terminal nets. The top-level port order is S, G, D, sky130_gnd; the model has its own D, G, S, bulk order. Parasitic capacitors are omitted here to make the interface visible."
import schemdraw as sd
import schemdraw.elements as elm
sd.svgconfig.svg2 = False

with sd.Drawing(canvas='svg') as d:
    d.config(unit=2, fontsize=15)
    m = d.add(elm.NFet(bulk=True).at((0, 0)).reverse())
    d.add(elm.Line().at(m.drain).up().length(0.8).dot().label('D', loc='top'))
    d.add(elm.Line().at(m.source).down().length(0.8).dot().label('S', loc='bottom'))
    d.add(elm.Line().at(m.gate).left().length(0.7).dot().label('G', loc='left'))
    d.add(elm.Line().at(m.bulk).right().length(1.5).dot().label('sky130_gnd', loc='right'))
    d.add(elm.Label().at((1.3, 0.2)).label('Xtail'))
```
